title: Witty Alien
post: No school. Goats. Then he beat Magnus Carlsen. #chess #wittyalien #magnuscarlsen #aliengambit #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: This guy never went to school.
phrases.say: [intrigued] This guy never went to school.

phrases.text: His dad wanted him to herd goats.
phrases.say: [deadpan] His dad wanted him to herd goats.

phrases.text: And he just beat Magnus Carlsen.
phrases.say: [excited] And he just beat... Magnus Carlsen!

phrases.text: Meet Witty Alien.
phrases.say: [playfully] Meet... Witty Alien.

phrases.text: Drenov. A tiny village in Bulgaria.
phrases.say: [storytelling] Drenov. A tiny village in Bulgaria.

phrases.text: The family kept goats. The kids took turns herding them. School? Not on the menu.
phrases.say: The family kept goats. The kids took turns herding them. [dry] School? Not on the menu.

phrases.text: So Volen taught himself. From first grade up.
phrases.say: [softly] So Volen taught himself. From first grade up.

phrases.text: His brother showed him chess. And the kid was good. Bulgarian youth champion good.
phrases.say: [impressed] His brother showed him chess. And the kid was good. Bulgarian youth champion good.

phrases.text: At seventeen, he left home. Alone and broke.
phrases.say: [serious] At seventeen, he left home. Alone... and broke.

phrases.text: He taught himself to code, became a programmer, and was bored out of his mind.
phrases.say: He taught himself to code, became a programmer, [sighs] and was bored out of his mind.

phrases.text: So in 2022 he quit to stream chess. With two hundred leva in his pocket. About a hundred bucks.
phrases.say: [mischievously] So in 2022 he quit to stream chess. With two hundred leva in his pocket. [laughs] About a hundred bucks.

phrases.text: Then he did something insane. Move six: he throws his knight onto f7. For a pawn.
phrases.say: [excited] Then he did something insane. Move six: he throws his knight onto f7. [whispers] For a pawn.

phrases.text: Engines hate it. Humans panic.
phrases.say: [dry] Engines hate it. [laughs] Humans panic.

phrases.text: He called it the Alien Gambit. And it blew up.
phrases.say: He called it the Alien Gambit. [excited] And it blew up.

phrases.text: September 2026. Five-minute blitz. Witty Alien versus Magnus Carlsen.
phrases.say: [dramatic] September 2026. Five-minute blitz. Witty Alien... versus Magnus Carlsen.

phrases.text: Magnus is crushing him.
phrases.say: [tense] Magnus is crushing him.

phrases.text: Then one natural move, and it's a blunder.
phrases.say: [whispers] Then one natural move... [gasps] and it's a blunder.

phrases.text: Rook check. Queen check. Magnus resigns.
phrases.say: [excited] Rook check! Queen check! Magnus resigns!

phrases.text: Witty Alien rips his shirt on stream.
phrases.say: [laughs] Witty Alien rips his shirt on stream.

phrases.text: His verdict? Pure luck.
phrases.say: [deadpan] His verdict? Pure luck.

phrases.text: Not bad for a kid who was supposed to herd goats.
phrases.say: [warmly] Not bad for a kid who was supposed to herd goats.
